title: BBC Three and BBC Scotland TV channels to be shut down next year
description:
Corporation announces broadcast closures and job losses in effort to find savings of £500m

  • UK politics live – latest updates

Television channels BBC Three and BBC Scotland are to close and the Radio 4 Extra radio station will be scrapped, as part of the corporation’s drive to cut £500m in costs.

Both TV channels are to move online as executives try to plug a funding crisis and adapt the broadcaster’s output for audiences that increasingly watch content on demand. All three outlets will close in the spring.
